question:
Select the correct option to fill in the blank:

'Sarah and her brother _______ to the university prep classes every weekday.'
explanation_tr: Özne 'Sarah and her brother' çoğul (They) olduğu için ve 'every weekday' geniş zaman (Simple Present) belirttiği için fiil yalın halde 'go' olarak gelmelidir.
explanation_en: The subject 'Sarah and her brother' is plural (they), and the habitual adverb 'every weekday' requires Simple Present 'go'.

question:
Which word best completes the sentence?

'It is _______ to memorize all these words in one day; it is better to study fifteen words every day.'
explanation_tr: Cümlenin devamında 'günde 15 kelime çalışmak daha iyidir' tavsiyesi verildiğine göre, tüm kelimeleri tek bir günde ezberlemek imkansızdır/mantıklı değildir ('impossible').
explanation_en: The second clause suggests spacing out study, indicating that cramming everything in one single day is 'impossible'.

question:
Select the sentence closest in meaning:

'Seldom has a technological advancement permeated everyday existence with such rapidity and profound societal implications as generative artificial intelligence.'

options.text: Hardly any prior technology has spread into daily life as swiftly or caused as deep a societal transformation as generative artificial intelligence.
Despite its swift spread, generative AI has produced negligible effects on social behavior.
Generative AI is just one of many typical technologies that have steadily integrated into society over time.
Society has readily rejected previous technologies in favor of generative artificial intelligence.

explanation_tr: Cümle 'Seldom has...' (Çok nadiren... / Neredeyse hiçbir zaman...) devrik yapısıyla başlar. Generative AI'ın günlük yaşama bu hız ve derin toplumsal etkilerle girmesinin tarihte eşine az rastlandığını belirtir. A seçeneğindeki 'Hardly any prior technology has spread... as swiftly or caused as deep a societal transformation...' ifadesi tam ve eksiksiz bir eşanlamdır.
explanation_en: The negative adverbial 'Seldom has...' emphasizes the unprecedented speed and depth of AI's societal adoption, which A paraphrases with precision.

question:
Choose the correct sentence to complete the conversation:

'Where _______ your roommate study in the evenings?'
explanation_tr: Tekil üçüncü şahıs ('your roommate' = he/she) ile Present Simple geniş zaman soru cümlesinde yardımcı fiil 'does' kullanılır: 'Where does your roommate study...?'
explanation_en: Third-person singular subjects ('your roommate') require the auxiliary verb 'does' in simple present questions.

question:
Select the correct connector to join the clauses:

'She arrived late to the lecture _______ there was a traffic jam on the highway.'
explanation_tr: Derse geç kalmanın nedeni otoyoldaki trafik sıkışıklığıdır. Neden-sonuç bildiren bağlaç 'because' (çünkü / -dığı için) olmalıdır.
explanation_en: 'Because' introduces the direct cause of her tardiness (the traffic jam).

question:
Choose the correct relative clause pronoun:

'The academic advisor with _______ I consulted recommended enrolling in an advanced academic writing seminar.'
explanation_tr: Edattan (preposition: 'with') sonra bir insanı niteleyen nesne zamiri olarak yalnızca 'whom' kullanılabilir: 'with whom I consulted'.
explanation_en: Prepositions preceding relative pronouns referring to people formally take 'whom' ('with whom').

question:
Select the word that best completes the scholarly criticism:

'The monograph's core thesis is fundamentally flawed; rather than illuminating historical causality, it serves merely to _______ the socio-political dynamics of the era with verbose jargon.'
explanation_tr: 'Rather than illuminating...' (aydınlatmaktan ziyade) ifadesi zıtlık gerektirir. 'Verbose jargon' (ağdalı/karmaşık terimler) kullanarak dönemin dinamiklerini 'anlaşılmaz kılmak / kasten perdelemek' ('obfuscate') eylemi eleştirilmektedir. 'Elucidate' (aydınlatmak) ve 'substantiate' (somutlaştırmak) zıt anlamlıdır.
explanation_en: 'Rather than illuminating' sets up a contrast with making obscure. 'Obfuscate' means to make unclear or unintelligible.

question:
Choose the correct word to complete the sentence:

'Can you please _______ the lights before you leave the lecture hall?'
explanation_tr: Işıkları söndürmek / kapatmak için kullanılan phrasal verb 'turn off' (veya 'switch off') tur.
explanation_en: 'Turn off' is the standard phrasal verb for extinguishing electric lights.

question:
Select the correct comparative structure:

'This semester's chemistry exam was _______ than the one we took last term.'
explanation_tr: 'Difficult' çok heceli bir sıfattır, comparative yapılırken başına 'more' alır. Karşılaştırmayı pekiştirmek için önüne 'much' getirilebilir: 'much more difficult than'.
explanation_en: Multi-syllable adjectives form comparatives with 'more'; 'much' intensifies the difference ('much more difficult than').

question:
Choose the correct modal verb of past deduction:

'Look at the wet pavement and puddles everywhere. It _______ heavily during the night.'
explanation_tr: Yerdeki su birikintileri ve ıslaklık kesin bir geçmiş kanıttır. Geçmişe yönelik güçlü olumlu çıkarım (strong past deduction) kalıbı 'must have + V3' (yağmış olmalı) dür.
explanation_en: 'Must have + past participle' expresses logical certainty about a past event based on present physical evidence.

question:
Choose the correct inverted conditional structure:

'_______ you encounter any technical anomalies during the simulation, notify the laboratory supervisor immediately.'
explanation_tr: 'If you should encounter...' (Eğer olur da karşılaşırsanız) kalıbının Type 1 Inversion biçimi 'Should you encounter...' dır. Cümle başına 'Should' getirilerek 'If' atılır.
explanation_en: 'Should you encounter' is an inverted first conditional equivalent to 'If you happen to encounter'.

question:
Choose the most sophisticated and grammatically precise option:

'Beneath the facade of diplomatic conviviality _______ an intense geopolitical rivalry for oceanic trade routes.'
explanation_tr: Yer bildiren edat tamlaması ('Beneath the facade of...') cümle başına geldiğinde özne ve fiil yer değiştirir (Locative Inversion: Prepositional Phrase + Verb + Subject). 'Lie' (yatmak/bulunmak) fiilinin Past Simple hali 'lay' dir. 'Laid' ise 'lay' (koymak/sermek) fiilinin geçmiş halidir. Burada 'bir rekabet yatıyordu/bulunuyordu' anlamında 'lay' doğru cevaptır.
explanation_en: Locative inversion with prepositional phrase requires the past tense of intransitive 'to lie' (lie - lay - lain), which is 'lay' (C).

question:
Select the correct passive voice construction:

'The scholarship application forms _______ to the registrar's office by Friday afternoon.'
explanation_tr: Formlar kendi kendini teslim edemez, teslim edilmelidir (Passive Voice: modal + be + V3). Doğru biçim 'must be submitted' dır.
explanation_en: Passive modal construction requires 'modal + be + past participle': 'must be submitted'.

question:
Choose the correct phrase to complete the conditional sentence:

'_______ the fire alarm sound during the examination, all candidates must vacate the auditorium in an orderly line.'
explanation_tr: Geniş zaman / gelecek zaman olası durumlarında Type 1 Inverted conditional: 'Should + Subject + V1' (Örn: 'Should the fire alarm sound...'). 'Were' olsaydı 'Were the fire alarm to sound' gerekirdi.
explanation_en: 'Should + subject + base verb' is the inverted form of 'If + subject + should/present verb'.

question:
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence:

'The central library _______ open on Sundays during the exam week.'
explanation_tr: 'The central library' tekil bir öznedir (it). Present simple 'to be' fiilinin tekil nesneler için çekimi 'is'tir.
explanation_en: 'The central library' is a third-person singular noun (it), which takes the singular verb 'is'.

question:
Choose the correct option:

'Our English instructor _______ clear explanations during the morning lectures.'
explanation_tr: Geniş zamanda (Simple Present Tense) 3. tekil şahıslar (he/she/it veya 'our instructor') için fiilin sonuna '-s' takısı gelir ('gives').
explanation_en: In the simple present tense, third-person singular subjects require the verb with an -s suffix ('gives').

question:
Choose the correct prepositions:

'The preparatory orientation meeting starts _______ 09:30 AM _______ Monday.'
explanation_tr: Saat bildiren kesin zaman ifadeleri için 'at' (at 09:30 AM), haftanın günleri için 'on' (on Monday) edatı kullanılır.
explanation_en: Clock times take the preposition 'at', whereas days of the week take 'on'.

question:
Choose the correct option:

'There aren't _______ empty seats left in lecture hall 101.'
explanation_tr: Olumsuz cümlelerde sayılabilen çoğul isimlerle ('empty seats') miktar belirtirken 'any' (hiç) kullanılır.
explanation_en: In negative sentences with plural countable nouns, 'any' is used to express zero quantity.

question:
Choose the correct question word:

'_______ does the campus shuttle bus arrive at the engineering faculty?' - 'Every fifteen minutes.'
explanation_tr: Cevapta 'Every fifteen minutes' (Her on beş dakikada bir) sıklık belirtildiği için soru 'How often' (Ne sıklıkla) olmalıdır.
explanation_en: The answer indicates frequency ('every fifteen minutes'), which is questioned with 'How often'.

question:
Choose the correct modal auxiliary:

'Students _______ borrow up to five books at a time from the university library.'
explanation_tr: Yetki ve izin (permission/ability) bildirmek için 'can' modalı doğrudan yalın fiil ile kullanılır ('can borrow').
explanation_en: 'Can' expresses permission and possibility followed directly by the base verb.

question:
Choose the correct word order:

'Prep students _______ late for morning vocabulary quizzes.'
explanation_tr: Sıklık zarfları (never, always, usually) 'to be' (am/is/are) yardımcı fiilinden SONRA gelir: 'are never late'.
explanation_en: Frequency adverbs appear after the verb 'to be' (e.g., 'are never').

question:
Choose the correct word:

'Please write your student _______ and name on the top corner of the exam paper.'
explanation_tr: 'Student number', üniversitelerde 'öğrenci numarası' terimidir.
explanation_en: 'Student number' is the standard compound noun for a university registration identifier.

question:
Choose the correct pronoun:

'Mark and Sarah lost _______ student ID cards in the campus cafeteria yesterday.'
explanation_tr: 'Mark and Sarah' çoğul 3. şahıstır (they). İsimden önce gelen iyelik sıfatı (possessive adjective) 'their' (onların) olmalıdır.
explanation_en: 'Mark and Sarah' is plural, requiring the possessive adjective 'their' before 'student ID cards'.

question:
Read the short campus notice:

'Notice to All Students: Room B-204 is closed for maintenance this Tuesday. The 10:00 AM General English lecture will take place in Auditorium 3.'

Where will the Tuesday morning English lecture take place?

question:
Choose the correct past tense form:

'Last night, the research assistant _______ all the laboratory data into the university database.'

explanation_en: 'Last night' triggers the past simple tense, requiring the past form 'entered'.

question:
Choose the correct verb forms:

'While the instructor _______ the grammar topic, the fire alarm suddenly _______.'

explanation_en: A continuous background activity (Past Continuous: 'was explaining') interrupted by a completed action (Past Simple: 'rang').

question:
Choose the correct comparative form:

'Digital dictionaries are usually _______ and more convenient than heavy printed volumes.'
explanation_tr: Tek heceli sıfatlar karşılaştırma (comparative) yaparken '-er' takısı alır: 'fast' -> 'faster'.
explanation_en: Single-syllable adjectives form their comparative with '-er' ('faster').

question:
Choose the correct connector:

'The student arrived early for the exam _______ he wanted to review his flashcards one last time.'

question:

'Look at the dark clouds gathering over the campus! It _______ rain soon.'
explanation_tr: Mevcut görsel bir kanıta ('dark clouds') dayalı gelecek tahminlerinde 'be going to' kalıbı kullanılır ('is going to rain').
explanation_en: Predictions based on immediate physical evidence require 'be going to'.

question:
Choose the correct relative pronoun:

'The professor _______ teaches academic writing is also the head of the department.'
explanation_tr: İnsanları niteleyen tanımlayıcı ilgi zamiri (defining relative pronoun) 'who'dur ('The professor who teaches...').
explanation_en: Persons are defined using the subject relative pronoun 'who'.

question:
Choose the correct conditional form:

'If you _______ your student card in the scanner, the library gate will open automatically.'
explanation_tr: First Conditional (Tip 1 Koşul) yapısında 'If' cümlesi Simple Present ('swipe'), ana cümle ise 'will + fiil' alır.
explanation_en: First conditional sentences employ present simple in the if-clause to discuss real future outcomes.

question:
Choose the correct modal of obligation:

'According to university regulations, prep students _______ attend at least 85% of all classes.'
explanation_tr: Resmi kural ve yönetmeliklerden kaynaklanan dışsal zorunluluklar 'have to' kalıbı ile ifade edilir.
explanation_en: 'Have to' signifies external obligations established by institutional rules and regulations.

question:
Choose the correct option:

'The teacher handed out the course _______ detailing exam dates and weekly reading assignments.'
explanation_tr: 'Syllabus', üniversite derslerinde haftalık okuma, ödev ve sınav tarihlerini gösteren 'ders izlencesi / planı'dır.
explanation_en: A 'syllabus' is an outline of subjects in a course of study with schedule and assignment details.

question:
Choose the correct present perfect sentence:

'I have _______ completed the online mock test, so I can check my score now.'
explanation_tr: Olumlu Present Perfect cümlelerinde bir işin çoktan / önceden tamamlandığını vurgulamak için 'already' kullanılır.
explanation_en: 'Already' is placed between the auxiliary and main verb in affirmative present perfect structures to denote completion.

question:
Choose the correct preposition:

'Students are responsible _______ keeping the computer laboratory clean and quiet.'
explanation_tr: 'Responsible' sıfatı her zaman 'for' edatı ile kullanılır: 'responsible for something' (bir şeyden sorumlu olmak).
explanation_en: The adjective 'responsible' is followed by the preposition 'for'.

question:
Read the text:

'Campus shuttle services operate every twenty minutes between 08:00 and 18:00. However, on weekends, buses run once an hour. Students must show a valid university ID to board free of charge.'

Which statement is TRUE according to the passage?

options.text: Students can ride the shuttle for free by presenting their student ID.
Shuttles run with the same frequency every day of the week.
Weekend shuttles depart every twenty minutes.
The shuttle service operates 24 hours a day.

explanation_tr: Metinde 'Students must show a valid university ID to board free of charge' (Öğrenciler geçerli kimlik göstererek ücretsiz binebilir) ifadesi A şıkkını doğrular.
explanation_en: The passage confirms that students ride free upon presenting valid university identification.

question:
Choose the correct verb form:

'Over the past five years, researchers at the faculty _______ significant breakthroughs in solar cell efficiency.'
explanation_tr: 'Over the past five years' (Son beş yılda) gibi geçmişten günümüze uzanan zaman aralıklarında Present Perfect Tense ('have achieved') kullanılır.
explanation_en: Time expressions covering a duration up to the present ('over the past...') require the present perfect tense.

question:
Choose the correct passive voice sentence:

'All proficiency exam papers _______ by a committee of senior language instructors next Monday.'
explanation_tr: Gelecek zaman belirteci 'next Monday' ve edilgen özne 'exam papers' birleştiğinde Future Simple Passive yapısı 'will be + V3' ('will be evaluated') olmalıdır.
explanation_en: Passive future construction is formed by 'will be + past participle'.

question:
Choose the correct conditional form:

'If university dormitory fees _______ more affordable, fewer students would struggle financially.'
explanation_tr: Mevcut duruma aykırı varsayımsal durumları anlatan Second Conditional (Tip 2) cümlesidir. If kısmında Past Simple ('were'), sonuç kısmında 'would + V1' kullanılır.
explanation_en: Second conditional hypothetical sentences take the past simple ('were') in the condition clause and 'would + verb' in the main clause.

question:
Choose the correct modal of deduction:

'The departmental office is locked and all lights are switched off. The administrative staff _______ for the day.'
explanation_tr: Işıkların sönük ve kapının kilitli olması gibi güçlü kanıtlara dayanarak geçmişe dair kesin çıkarım (past deduction) yaparken 'must have + V3' ('must have left' - çıkmış olmalılar) kullanılır.
explanation_en: 'Must have + past participle' expresses logical certainty regarding a past occurrence based on direct evidence.

question:
Choose the correct gerund or infinitive:

'The department strictly prohibits students from _______ unverified sources in their academic term papers.'
explanation_tr: 'Prohibit somebody from doing something' kalıbında 'from' edatından sonra fiil '-ing' (gerund) alır: 'citing'.
explanation_en: Prepositions (such as 'from') must be followed by a gerund (-ing form).

question:
Choose the correct connector:

'_______ intensive preparation over several weeks, many candidates still experienced test anxiety during the listening section.'
explanation_tr: Boşluktan sonra bir isim öbeği ('intensive preparation...') geldiği için zıtlık bildiren ve isimle kullanılan 'Despite' (veya 'In spite of') uygundur. 'Although' ise tam cümle ister.
explanation_en: 'Despite' functions as a preposition followed directly by a noun phrase, unlike 'although' which requires a clause.

question:
Choose the correct relative clause:

'The academic advisor _______ recommendations I followed helped me secure a research scholarship.'
explanation_tr: Danışmanın tavsiyeleri (aitlik/mülkiyet) anlamını vermek için iyelik bildiren ilgi zamiri 'whose' ('whose recommendations') kullanılır.
explanation_en: 'Whose' is the possessive relative pronoun indicating that the recommendations belonged to the advisor.

question:
Choose the correct academic collocation:

'The university grant enabled the faculty to _______ extensive research into urban water pollution.'
explanation_tr: Akademik İngilizcede 'araştırma yürütmek / yapmak' fiil eşdizimi 'conduct research' (veya 'carry out research') şeklindedir.
explanation_en: 'Conduct research' is the formal academic collocation for carrying out scientific investigations.

question:
Choose the sentence closest in meaning:

'Unless students submit their medical reports within three days of the exam, make-up requests will be denied.'

options.text: Make-up examinations are automatically cancelled for all students regardless of medical reports.
Students will only be granted a make-up examination if they deliver their medical documentation within three days.
Medical reports are completely rejected if students fail the original examination.
Students who deliver their reports after three days are still eligible for make-up testing.

explanation_tr: 'Unless' (olmadıkça / -medikçe) yapısı 'if not' demektir. Yani öğrenciler 3 gün içinde rapor vermezse mazeret sınavı hakkı alamazlar; dolayısıyla yalnızca 3 gün içinde teslim ederlerse mazeret sınavına girebilirler (B şıkkı).
explanation_en: 'Unless' is equivalent to 'if not', meaning make-up approval is conditional solely upon delivering documentation within three days.

question:
Choose the correct option:

'Engineering students are accustomed to _______ complex mathematical equations using computational software.'
explanation_tr: 'Be accustomed to' (bir şeye alışkın olmak) kalıbındaki 'to' bir edattır ve ardından gelen eylem '-ing' (gerund) alır: 'accustomed to solving'.
explanation_en: The phrase 'be accustomed to' requires a gerund (-ing) because 'to' functions as a preposition.

question:
Read the passage:

'Urban vertical farming represents an innovative method of food production where crops are cultivated in stacked horizontal layers within controlled indoor environments. By utilizing artificial lighting and hydroponics, these facilities require ninety-five percent less water than conventional agricultural fields. Furthermore, proximity to urban consumers dramatically diminishes transportation emissions.'

What is one stated advantage of vertical farming over traditional agriculture?

options.text: It requires vast expanses of rural land.
It relies entirely on natural sunlight.

explanation_tr: Metinde vertical farming'in geleneksel tarıma göre '%95 daha az su gerektirdiği' ('require 95% less water') açıkça belirtilmiştir.
explanation_en: The text states that vertical facilities require ninety-five percent less water than conventional agricultural fields.

question: Based on the passage in the previous question, why does vertical farming reduce transportation emissions?

options.text: Because vertical farms rely solely on international shipping.
Because consumers travel to rural farms to purchase food.
Because produce is grown close to city consumers.
Because diesel freight trucks are subsidized.

explanation_tr: Metindeki 'proximity to urban consumers dramatically diminishes transportation emissions' cümlesi, kentteki tüketicilere yakınlığın taşımacılık kaynaklı karbon emisyonunu azalttığını vurgular.
explanation_en: The passage links emission reductions directly to vertical farms' proximity to urban population centers.

question:
Complete the academic sentence:

'The research team discovered that _______ the participants adhered to the strict dietary regimen, the results varied considerably.'
explanation_tr: Cümlede zıtlık (concession) ilişkisi vardır: Katılımcılar katı diyete uymuş olmalarına RAĞMEN sonuçlar değişkenlik göstermiştir ('even though').
explanation_en: 'Even though' introduces a concession clause explaining an unexpected outcome despite strict adherence.

question:
Choose the correct reported speech form:

Direct speech: 'The exam will take place in Hall A,' the coordinator announced.
Reported speech: The coordinator announced that the exam _______ in Hall A.
explanation_tr: Dolaylı anlatımda (Reported Speech) ana fiil geçmiş zaman ('announced') olduğunda 'will', 'would' haline dönüşür ('would take place').
explanation_en: In indirect speech introduced by a past reporting verb, 'will' backshifts to 'would'.

question:
Complete the academic sentence:

'The anthropologist argued that societal rituals are not arbitrary gestures; _______, they serve as crucial mechanisms for reinforcing social solidarity.'
explanation_tr: Cümlede 'ritüeller keyfi değildir; BİLAKİS / AKSİNE toplumsal dayanışmayı güçlendiren mekanizmalardır' anlamı vardır. Birinci cümlenin olumsuzluğu ardından karşıt gerçeği sunarken 'on the contrary' (bilakis/aksine) kullanılır.
explanation_en: 'On the contrary' introduces a statement refuting the preceding negative assertion.

question:
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence:

'Every morning, the university library _______ at 8:00 a.m. and welcomes hundreds of students.'
explanation_tr: [Genel Hazırlık Çözümü] 'Every morning' (her sabah) ifadesi düzenli tekrarlanan bir geniş zaman (Present Simple) eylemini gösterir. Tekil özne ('the university library') ile fiile '-s' takısı gelerek 'opens' kullanılır.
explanation_en: 'Every morning' indicates a habitual action in the Present Simple tense. With the singular subject 'the university library', 'opens' is correct.

question:
Select the most appropriate word to complete the sentence:

'New students must _______ their student ID cards at the main entrance before entering the campus.'
explanation_tr: [Genel Hazırlık Çözümü] Kampüse girmeden önce ana girişte öğrenci kimlik kartlarının 'gösterilmesi' (show) gerekir. 'Borrow' ödünç almak, 'forget' unutmak demektir.
explanation_en: Students need to 'show' (present) their ID cards at the entrance gate.

question:
Complete the sentence with the correct form:

'While the professor _______ the experimental results on the board, the projector suddenly turned off.'
explanation_tr: [Genel Hazırlık Çözümü] Geçmişte devam etmekte olan uzun bir eylem ('While the professor was explaining...') sırasında ani bir olay ('turned off') gerçekleştiğinde Past Continuous ('was explaining') kullanılır.
explanation_en: 'While' introduces a background action in progress in the past (Past Continuous: 'was explaining') interrupted by a shorter action ('turned off').

question:
Choose the best response to complete the dialogue:

Student: 'Excuse me, could you tell me when the proficiency exam application deadline is?'
Advisor: '_______'

options.text: The exam consists of reading, listening, and essay writing.
You should study academic vocabulary every day.
All applications must be submitted online by Friday at 5:00 p.m.
Yes, the library is on the second floor of this building.

explanation_tr: [Genel Hazırlık Çözümü] Öğrenci muafiyet sınavı son başvuru tarihini ('application deadline') sormaktadır. Danışmanın 'Tüm başvurular Cuma günü saat 17:00'ye kadar çevrimiçi teslim edilmelidir' yanıtı soruyu doğrudan karşılar.
explanation_en: The student asks about the application deadline, so specifying Friday at 5:00 p.m. directly answers the question.

question:
Complete the sentence:

'Students _______ submit their research proposals on time will not be allowed to participate in the spring symposium.'
explanation_tr: [Genel Hazırlık Çözümü] 'Students' (insan öznesi) niteleyen bir relative clause yapısında fiille devam eden özne zamiri olarak 'who fail to' (teslim etmekte başarısız olan / teslim etmeyen öğrenciler) kullanılır.
explanation_en: A subject relative pronoun referring to people ('Students') followed by a verb is required: 'who fail to'.

question:
Choose the correct academic word:

'Regular attendance and active participation in seminars _______ significantly to a student's language development.'
explanation_tr: [Genel Hazırlık Çözümü] 'To' edatı ile birlikte kullanılan ve 'katkıda bulunmak' anlamına gelen akademik fiil 'contribute' (contribute to) yapısıdır.
explanation_en: 'Contribute to' means to help cause or bring about improvement.

question:
Complete the sentence logically:

'Although online learning platforms offer remarkable flexibility for university students, _______.'

options.text: students no longer need internet access to attend virtual lectures
they cannot completely replace face-to-face academic interaction in laboratories
consequently, traditional classrooms have never existed in modern education
because digital resources are accessible from any mobile device

explanation_tr: [Genel Hazırlık Çözümü] 'Although' (rağmen) ile başlayan yan cümlede çevrimiçi öğrenmenin esneklik sunduğu (olumlu özellik) belirtilmiştir. Ana cümlede ise bu duruma zıt/sınırlayıcı bir yargı ('laboratuvarlardaki yüz yüze akademik etkileşimin yerini tamamen alamazlar') gelmelidir.
explanation_en: 'Although' requires a contrasting main clause highlighting a limitation of online learning.

question:
Choose the sentence closest in meaning to the given sentence:

'No matter how meticulously the engineers calibrated the telescope, atmospheric turbulence still blurred the distant galaxy images.'

options.text: Because the engineers failed to calibrate the telescope carefully, atmospheric turbulence ruined the galaxy photographs.
The more carefully the engineers calibrated the telescope, the clearer the images of distant galaxies became despite the atmosphere.
Even though the engineers calibrated the telescope with great precision, atmospheric turbulence continued to blur the images of distant galaxies.
Atmospheric turbulence only blurred the images when the engineers neglected to calibrate the telescope properly.

explanation_tr: [Genel Hazırlık Çözümü] 'No matter how meticulously...' (ne kadar titizlikle kalibre ederlerse etsinler) yapısı 'Even though ... with great precision' (büyük bir hassasiyetle kalibre etmelerine rağmen) ile birebir aynı zıtlık anlamını verir.
explanation_en: 'No matter how meticulously' expresses concession, equivalent to 'Even though ... with great precision'.

question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate transition:

'Empirical studies indicate that sleep deprivation impairs short-term memory consolidation; _______, students who stay awake all night before an exam often perform worse than expected.'
explanation_tr: [Genel Hazırlık Çözümü] İlk cümlede uykusuzluğun kısa süreli hafızayı zayıflattığı (neden), ikinci cümlede ise sınavdan önce bütün gece uyanık kalan öğrencilerin beklenenden düşük performans gösterdiği (sonuç) ifade edilmektedir. Neden-sonuç bağlacı olan 'therefore' (bu nedenle / dolayısıyla) doğrudur.
explanation_en: The second clause is a direct logical consequence of the first clause, requiring 'therefore'.

question:
Select the word that best completes the academic sentence:

'Before implementing the new urban transportation policy, the municipality conducted a _______ feasibility study covering all districts.'
explanation_tr: [Genel Hazırlık Çözümü] 'Covering all districts' (tüm ilçeleri kapsayan) ifadesi yapılan fizibilite çalışmasının 'kapsamlı / geniş çaplı' (comprehensive) olduğunu gösterir. 'Negligible' ihmal edilebilir, 'superficial' yüzeysel demektir.
explanation_en: 'Covering all districts' points to a thorough, all-inclusive ('comprehensive') study.

question: According to the passage, which of the following is proposed as a solution to reduce the urban heat island effect?

options.text: Replacing reflective materials with darker asphalt pavements
Installing green roofs and expanding tree cover in cities
Increasing the use of air conditioning units in public buildings
Concentrating taller buildings in the center of metropolitan areas

explanation_tr: [Genel Hazırlık Çözümü] Parçanın son cümlesinde bu etkileri azaltmak ('To mitigate these effects') için şehir plancılarının yeşil çatıları ('green roofs'), yansıtıcı bina malzemelerini ve ağaç örtüsünü artırmayı savunduğu açıkça belirtilmiştir.
explanation_en: The final sentence explicitly states that urban planners advocate for green roofs and expanded tree canopies to mitigate urban heat islands.
passage: Urban heat islands occur when cities replace natural land cover with dense concentrations of pavement, buildings, and other surfaces that absorb and retain heat. This phenomenon not only increases energy demand for air conditioning during summer months but also elevates air pollution levels and heat-related health risks. To mitigate these effects, urban planners increasingly advocate for green roofs, reflective building materials, and expanded tree canopies across metropolitan areas.

question:
Choose the grammatically correct option:

'Seldom _______ such a profound shift in global supply chains as the one triggered by recent semiconductor shortages.'
explanation_tr: [Genel Hazırlık Çözümü] Cümle başına olumsuz veya kısıtlayıcı bir zarf ('Seldom', 'Rarely', 'Never', 'Hardly') geldiğinde devrik yapı (Inversion: Yardımcı Fiil + Özne + Ana Fiil) zorunludur: 'Seldom have economists witnessed...'.
explanation_en: Negative/restrictive adverbs like 'Seldom' placed at the beginning of a clause require subject-auxiliary inversion: 'have economists witnessed'.

question:
Choose the sentence closest in meaning:

'Scarcely had the archaeological team unearthed the bronze tablets when heavy monsoon rains forced them to suspend the excavation.'

options.text: The archaeological team could not find any bronze tablets because heavy monsoon rains stopped the excavation early.
Long before the monsoon rains began, the archaeologists had already completed their analysis of the bronze tablets.
Despite the heavy monsoon rains, the archaeological team continued digging until they unearthed the bronze tablets.
Almost immediately after the archaeologists discovered the bronze tablets, they had to halt the excavation due to severe monsoon rains.

explanation_tr: [Genel Hazırlık Çözümü] 'Scarcely had ... when ...' kalıbı 'No sooner ... than ...' ve 'Hardly ... when ...' gibi bir eylem tamamlanır tamamlanmaz hemen ardından diğerinin gerçekleştiğini ('Almost immediately after...') anlatır.
explanation_en: 'Scarcely had X happened when Y happened' means Y occurred almost immediately after X.

question:
Choose the sentence that best completes the paragraph:

'Antibiotic resistance has emerged as one of the most pressing threats to modern medicine. For decades, the overuse of antimicrobial drugs in both human healthcare and livestock farming has accelerated the natural selection of resistant bacterial strains. _______. Without coordinated global action on both fronts, routine surgical procedures could once again carry life-threatening risks.'

options.text: Addressing this crisis requires not only stricter prescription regulations but also substantial investment in novel classes of antibiotics
Consequently, viral infections such as the common cold can now be cured effortlessly with standard penicillin
Most pharmaceutical companies have therefore doubled their production of traditional vitamins for domestic pets
Historical records show that ancient civilizations relied heavily on herbal remedies before the twentieth century

explanation_tr: [Genel Hazırlık Çözümü] Boşluktan sonraki cümlede 'Without coordinated global action on both fronts' (her iki cephede eşgüdümlü küresel eylem olmadan) ifadesi yer almaktadır. Dolayısıyla boşluğa bu 'iki cepheyi' (hem reçete düzenlemelerinin sıkılaştırılması hem de yeni antibiyotik sınıflarına yatırım yapılması) tanımlayan cümle gelmelidir.
explanation_en: The following sentence refers to 'both fronts', which links directly to 'not only stricter prescription regulations but also substantial investment in novel classes of antibiotics'.

question:
Select the most precise academic word to fill in the blank:

'The historian's new monograph was praised for its _______ analysis, seamlessly weaving together economic data, diplomatic archives, and cultural theory.'
explanation_tr: [Genel Hazırlık Çözümü] Ekonomik verileri, diplomatik arşivleri ve kültür teorisini kusursuzca birleştiren bir analiz 'derin bilgili / kapsamlı akademik birikime dayalı' (erudite) olarak övülür. 'Ephemeral' geçici, 'perfunctory' üstünkörü, 'fallacious' yanıltıcı demektir.
explanation_en: 'Erudite' means showing great academic knowledge and scholarship, fitting the praise for a richly interdisciplinary monograph.

question: [Genel Kur Alıştırması #1 • A1] Had the research committee reviewed the data on renewable energy grids and battery storage capacity earlier, the project ____ approved before the end of the semester.
explanation_tr: Sürdürülebilir enerji şebekeleri ve batarya depolama kapasitesi konusundaki bu koşul cümlesinde geçmiş zamanlı Type 3 / Mixed yapı (Had + V3 -> would have been V3) gereklidir.

question: [Genel Kur Alıştırması #2 • A1] Recent empirical studies on cognitive psychology and long-term memory consolidation have ____ the importance of standardized methodology across academic institutions.
explanation_tr: Cümlede bilişsel psikoloji ve uzun süreli bellek pekişmesi araştırmalarının standart metodolojinin önemini vurguladığı (underscored) ifade edilmektedir.

question: [Genel Kur Alıştırması #3 • A1] According to the academic excerpt on international trade tariffs and supply chain resilience, what is the primary factor that determines long-term institutional success?

options.text: Relying exclusively on unverified historical assumptions.
Eliminating all peer-review procedures to save time.
Avoiding technological updates in laboratory settings.
Systematic integration of empirical feedback and interdisciplinary collaboration.

explanation_tr: Parçada uluslararası ticaret tarifeleri ve tedarik zinciri dayanıklılığı kapsamında uzun vadeli başarının ampirik geri bildirim ve disiplinlerarası işbirliğine dayandığı belirtilmektedir.
passage: Academic Review (A1): Over the last decade, interdisciplinary research on international trade tariffs and supply chain resilience has demonstrated that institutions combining empirical feedback loops with collaborative peer review consistently outperform isolated research units.

question: [Genel Kur Alıştırması #4 • A1] Which of the following best restates: 'Not until the independent audit on biodiversity conservation in Mediterranean marine ecosystems was published did the board revise its operational guidelines.'

options.text: The board revised its operational guidelines only after the independent audit on biodiversity conservation in Mediterranean marine ecosystems had been published.
The board refused to revise its operational guidelines even after the audit on biodiversity conservation in Mediterranean marine ecosystems was published.
Before the independent audit on biodiversity conservation in Mediterranean marine ecosystems was published, the board had already revised all guidelines.
The publication of the audit on biodiversity conservation in Mediterranean marine ecosystems prevented the board from revising its operational guidelines.

explanation_tr: 'Not until ... did ...' devrik yapısı, eylemin ancak belirtilen olay gerçekleştiğinde (only after) yapıldığını anlatır.

question: [Genel Kur Alıştırması #5 • A1] Researchers investigating algorithmic transparency in automated medical diagnostics must account for external variables; ____, their statistical models may yield misleading correlations.
explanation_tr: Önceki cümledeki gereklilik yerine getirilmezse doğacak olumsuz sonucu bağlamak için 'otherwise' (aksi takdirde) kullanılır.

question: [Genel Kur Alıştırması #6 • A1] While initial hypotheses regarding urban microclimate regulation through vertical greening focused on short-term cost reductions, ____.

options.text: therefore no researchers ever examined the topic again
because the equipment had already been dismantled decades ago
subsequent longitudinal studies revealed that long-term durability is far more critical
unless the laboratory funding is completely canceled yesterday

explanation_tr: 'While' zıtlık bağlacı ile başlayan yan cümleyi anlam ve zaman bakımından tamamlayan seçenek uzun vadeli dayanıklılığı vurgulayan ifadedir.

question: [Genel Kur Alıştırması #7 • A1] Modern scholarship on archaeological stratigraphy in Bronze Age Anatolian settlements has evolved rapidly over the past decade. ____. Consequently, universities have updated their curricula to reflect these new analytical frameworks.

options.text: However, ancient pottery techniques remain unchanged in rural workshops
On the other hand, students rarely use libraries during summer vacations
For this reason, all academic journals ceased publication last century
New computational tools now allow researchers to process large-scale datasets with unprecedented accuracy

explanation_tr: Paragraftaki gelişimi ve sonrasındaki 'Consequently' (Sonuç olarak müfredatlar güncellendi) ifadesini mantıksal olarak bağlayan cümle yeni hesaplama araçlarının sağladığı dönüşümdür.

question:
[Genel Kur Alıştırması #8 • A1]
Student: Have you seen the latest departmental report on behavioral economics and consumer decision-making biases?
Advisor: ____
Student: That makes sense; I will include those updated figures in my literature review.

options.text: Yes, it was released this morning and contains several updated statistical tables.
No, the library building was closed for renovation five years ago.
I prefer taking the train rather than driving to campus on Mondays.
You should drop the course before the registration deadline expires.

explanation_tr: Öğrencinin 'güncellenmiş rakamları literatür taramama ekleyeceğim' yanıtıyla örtüşen danışman ifadesi raporun bu sabah yayımlandığını belirten seçenektir.

question: [Genel Kur Alıştırması #9 • A1] Had the research committee reviewed the data on neuroplasticity during second-language acquisition in adults earlier, the project ____ approved before the end of the semester.
explanation_tr: Yetişkinlerde ikinci dil edinimi sırasında nöroplastisite konusundaki bu koşul cümlesinde geçmiş zamanlı Type 3 / Mixed yapı (Had + V3 -> would have been V3) gereklidir.

question: [Genel Kur Alıştırması #10 • A1] Recent empirical studies on autonomous maritime navigation and collision avoidance protocols have ____ the importance of standardized methodology across academic institutions.
explanation_tr: Cümlede otonom deniz seyrüseferi ve çarpışma önleme protokolleri araştırmalarının standart metodolojinin önemini vurguladığı (underscored) ifade edilmektedir.

question: [Genel Kur Alıştırması #11 • A1] According to the academic excerpt on renewable energy grids and battery storage capacity, what is the primary factor that determines long-term institutional success?

options.text: Relying exclusively on unverified historical assumptions.
Eliminating all peer-review procedures to save time.
